_comment: Operator decision 2026-10-19: the 5/10/30 s motion loop stays a systemd user service (tradeai-active-trader-motion.service; n8n's minimum schedule is 1 min and its runs are stateless processes), and n8n OWNS its supervision through lane active-trader-motion-watchdog (*/5, tradeai-dispatcher) running scripts/check_active_trader_motion_heartbeat.py. The checker is read-only towards the runtime: it reads the heartbeat, /proc/<pid>/cmdline and the marker's existence, and never restarts, stops or edits anything. Alerts only through the host comms-intent path (config/host_comms_intent_routes.json host/active_trader_motion_watchdog, DIGEST -> P2), once per band change. Changed only by reviewed PR.
heartbeat_path_basis: the host env file ~/.config/tradeai/active-trader-motion.env points ACTIVE_TRADER_MOTION_HEARTBEAT at the dev tree (config/lane_registry.json row tradeai-active-trader-motion-service output_signal); the release-relative default does not exist
stale_basis: the runtime rewrites the heartbeat every cycle: 5 s active, 10 s near-fire, 30 s idle, bounded backoff max 30 s (config/systemd/active-trader-motion.env.example); 120 s is four idle cycles

window.basis: the runtime itself runs around the clock; motion evidence is consumed by the Active Trader desk from the pre-market scan through the close. Trading days and the official close (13:00 on early-close days) come from scripts/lib/cio_market_session.py, the repo's NYSE calendar. Outside the window a verdict is computed and reported but never alerts.

alert.dedupe: band change only: an alert band is queued once when the band first differs from the last alerted band; HEALTHY after an alert band queues one recovery line; DISABLED (operator gate) never alerts
